requirements.text: The AI Act classification of the model under AI-POL-001 is verified as correct and documented, including the assessment against Annex III point 5(b) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §4.1.

requirements.text: For high-risk AI systems the validation covers the requirements of AI Act Articles 10, 14 and 15 relevant to the model.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to high-risk AI systems (creditworthiness assessment of natural persons) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §4.1.

requirements.text: The use of an ML technique is justified against an interpretable alternative, considering the measured performance uplift, the explainability achieved and the intended use.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §4.2.

requirements.text: The model is tested for target leakage and for leakage between training, test and out-of-time samples, including the same obligor or customer appearing in more than one sample.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §5.1.

requirements.text: Each feature has a documented definition, lineage and business rationale, and at least the 20 most important features are independently reproduced from source data.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §5.2.

requirements.text: Protected characteristics are not used as features unless permitted under AI-POL-001, and features are screened for proxies of protected characteristics.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs affect natural persons only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §5.4.

requirements.text: Training, validation and testing data are relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended use (AI Act Art. 10(3)), assessed with the tests of MV-HB-003 §6.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §5.5.

requirements.text: Global feature importance is independently computed with at least one model-agnostic method, such as SHAP or permutation importance, and compared with the developer's results.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §6.1.

requirements.text: The direction and shape of the main feature effects are assessed with partial dependence or ALE plots, and violations of expected monotonic relationships are justified or constrained.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §6.2.

requirements.text: Local explanations and reason codes for outputs affecting individual customers are stable, faithful to the model and meaningful to the user.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs affect natural persons only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §6.3.

requirements.text: Fairness testing is performed across protected characteristics for which data is lawfully available, in line with AI-POL-001 and PRIV-POL-001.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs affect natural persons only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §7.1.

requirements.text: Fairness metrics include the adverse-impact ratio (amber below 0.80), the true-positive-rate difference between groups (amber above 5 percentage points) and within-group calibration.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs affect natural persons only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §7.2.

requirements.text: A disparity beyond the thresholds is accepted only if explained by a documented legitimate risk factor with no less discriminatory alternative of comparable performance; otherwise it is at least a Medium finding.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs affect natural persons only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §7.3.

requirements.text: Processing of special categories of personal data for fairness testing is limited to what AI Act Art. 10(5) and PRIV-POL-001 permit.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs affect natural persons only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §7.4.

requirements.text: Perturbation tests apply changes of at least ±5% to continuous inputs, and a share of changed grades or decisions above 5% is rated amber.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §8.1.

requirements.text: Model behaviour for missing, out-of-range and extreme input values is tested, and the implemented handling matches the documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §8.2.

requirements.text: For models exposed to adversarial behaviour, adversarial tests simulating evasion or manipulation are performed and the resulting performance degradation is reported.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud, AML and GenAI models exposed to adversarial behaviour only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §8.3.

requirements.text: Risks of data poisoning, model extraction and model inversion are assessed with Information Security, in support of AI Act Art. 15(5).
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §8.4.

requirements.text: The GenAI evaluation set contains at least 300 use-case-specific prompts covering typical, edge-case and adversarial inputs, with reference answers prepared or reviewed by subject-matter experts.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to generative AI applications only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §9.1.

requirements.text: Groundedness is measured on the evaluation set; groundedness below 95% is amber and below 90% red.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to generative AI applications only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §9.2.

requirements.text: The hallucination rate is measured on the evaluation set; a rate above 2% is amber and above 5% red, with a red threshold of 2% for customer-facing applications.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to generative AI applications only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §9.3.

requirements.text: Guardrails are tested against prompt injection, jailbreaks, toxic content, data leakage and out-of-scope requests; a red-team block rate below 98% or any personal data leakage is red.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to generative AI applications only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §9.4.

requirements.text: An LLM used as automated evaluator agrees with human evaluation on at least 100 samples with agreement of at least 85%; otherwise its results are invalid.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to generative AI applications only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §9.5.

requirements.text: A change of foundation model or version, system prompt or retrieval configuration is treated as a model change and groundedness, hallucination and guardrail tests are re-executed before deployment.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to generative AI applications only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §9.7.

requirements.text: Vendor documentation is sufficient to assess methodology, training data, performance and limitations; where it is not, compensating outcome-based testing is performed and a finding is raised.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to third-party AI models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §10.1.

requirements.text: A third-party model is outcome-tested on the bank's own data before first use.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to third-party AI models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §10.2.

requirements.text: The vendor contract provides access to validation-relevant information and notification of model changes, and notified changes trigger a change validation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to third-party AI models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §10.3.

requirements.text: The monitoring plan contains AI-specific metrics with consistent thresholds: feature drift, performance, fairness and, for GenAI, sampled hallucination rate, guardrail triggers and user feedback.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §11.1.

requirements.text: Human oversight under AI Act Art. 14 is effective, as evidenced by override logs and a sample of human reviews of model outputs.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §11.3.

requirements.text: Automatic retraining follows a validated protocol defining permitted changes and performance boundaries, and retrained versions outside these boundaries are subject to change validation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine-learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-STD-020 §11.4.
